selected.assay: bulk mRNA-seq of vastus lateralis biopsies, human males (S2.5.5.2.p1)
selected.design: randomized double-blind 2x2 crossover of OLE (Active) vs placebo; between-subject exercise type MICE (n=10) or SIE (n=10); biopsies Pre, Post, 24h in each crossover period (S2.2.p1, S2.4.p1, S2.5.5.3.p1)
selected.sample_inclusion: all 119 available biopsies (19 subjects x 6, one subject x 5) in one model (S2.5.5.3.p1)
selected.primary_estimand: exercise effect on muscle mRNA within the placebo arm: Post vs Pre and 24h vs Pre, separately for MICE and SIE (S3.3.p1; FIG4 legend: response with placebo ingestion)
planned_contrasts: MICE placebo Post vs Pre (S3.3.p1; 3883 DEGs)
selected.secondary_estimands: OLE effect corrected for exercise at Post and 24h (S3.4.p1, FIG6) - not the exercise question; only exploratory comparisons
selected.paper_method: edgeR filterByExpr + TMM, limma voomWithQualityWeights, duplicateCorrelation (twice) on donor, BH (S2.5.5.3.p2)

decisions.reason: S3.3.p1 gives the exercise DEG counts at FDR<0.05 with no fold-change cutoff; FIG4 legend says these are the response with placebo ingestion, 10 participants per exercise group. S2.5.5.3.p1-p2 give inclusion and the limma-voom + duplicateCorrelation method.

checks: DA.p1 names GSE318937 as the RNA-seq deposit
20 subjects, MICE/SIE 10/10 (59/60 samples), Active/Placebo, Pre/Post/Post24h match S2.4.p1
protocol 2021-00373 in titles matches CER-VD protocol in S2.1.p1

decisions.reason: Metadata and the single deposited count matrix belong to this paper's trial.

Matrix columns are library numbers; metadata description holds 'Library name: <n>' (inspect: 119/119 match). Exact match on the derived key. Short columns: ex (MICE/SIE), trt (OLE/PLA), time (Pre/Post/H24), subject (S##, recoded so it is categorical), period/sequence kept for the confounding check.

selected.paper_input: STAR-aligned gene counts filtered by filterByExpr and TMM-normalized inside edgeR/voom (S2.5.5.2.p1, S2.5.5.3.p2)

candidates: raw_counts (confirm against provenance: normalized integers and rounded estimated counts look the same)

decisions.reason: 100% integer values, 0 to 3.3e6, Ensembl gene IDs, 62754 genes (unfiltered); data_processing says STAR alignment then edgeR filterByExpr/TMM, so the deposit is the raw count matrix. Raw counts support DESeq2 and voom.

selected.analysis_type: multi-factor repeated measures, stratified by exercise type
selected.formula: ~ subject + cell (cell = time x trt) within each exercise stratum

decisions.reason: Exercise type is between-subject (each participant did only MICE or SIE), so a subject fixed effect is aliased with an exercise main effect in one model; each exercise group is fitted separately (strata=ex) with all 59/60 of its biopsies (both crossover arms, all times). Planned: time Post and H24 vs Pre within placebo (S3.3.p1, FIG4). Other comparisons the report lists (OLE-arm time effects, OLE vs PLA per time, time x trt interactions) run as exploratory.

covariates.name: subject
covariates.disposition: blocking term (fixed effect) for repeated biopsies per participant

covariates.name: period
covariates.disposition: not adjusted: paper did not; the planned time contrasts compare biopsies of the same session/period

covariates.name: sequence
covariates.disposition: not adjusted: between-subject, absorbed by the subject term

decisions.reason: S2.5.5.3.p2 accounts for repeated measures per donor with duplicateCorrelation; we block on subject as a fixed effect instead (deviation recorded in the method gate).

selected.method: DESeq2 (pydeseq2 Wald, joint cell-means model with subject blocking)

paper_route.method: limma voomWithQualityWeights + duplicateCorrelation on donor (edgeR filterByExpr, TMM)
paper_route.reason: no executor implements voomWithQualityWeights or duplicateCorrelation in a multi-level model; run_limma_voom_analysis is two-arm without blocking

deviations: DESeq2 with subject as fixed blocking effect instead of limma-voom with a subject correlation
each exercise group fitted separately instead of one 119-sample model
sensitivity: limma on log2(CPM+1) with subject fixed effect, planned contrasts only

decisions.reason: Raw counts; the DESeq2 joint model keeps all biopsies of the exercise group and blocks on subject. limma on log2(CPM+1) with subject blocking runs as a sensitivity closer to the paper's limma family.

selected.deviation_note: paper FDR<0.05 (BH) applied to DESeq2/limma results from the deviation route

decisions.reason: one DESeq2 model on all 59 MICE biopsies; planned placebo time contrasts are primary, others exploratory
one DESeq2 model on all 60 SIE biopsies
limma family like the paper, subject blocking as fixed effect
